title: Log window summary with percentiles
prompt: Build a CLI reading JSON Lines from stdin (LF or CRLF line endings; blank lines are skipped but still count for line numbers, which are 1-based physical lines). A valid line is a JSON object with ts (an ISO 8601 timestamp with seconds and an explicit offset such as Z or +02:00, fractional seconds allowed) and ms (a finite non-negative JSON number). Any other nonblank line is rejected. Windows are 60-second intervals aligned to the Unix epoch in UTC, [start,start+60s), so offsets are converted to instants first. For each nonempty window compute count and the nearest-rank percentiles p50 and p95 of ms: sort ascending, the p-th percentile is the value at 1-based rank ceil(p/100*count). Print exactly one JSON object and a newline: {windows,rejected}. windows is ordered by start and lists {start,count,p50,p95} with start formatted like 2026-03-01T10:00:00.000Z; rejected lists the rejected line numbers ascending. Input order does not matter. Empty input gives {"windows":[],"rejected":[]}. Exit 0 whenever the input could be read. No external services are needed.
